description: Ordinance-flow draft-step cases. The draft step is chosen because it synthesises from already-hydrated prior-step data instead of researching live, so two variants answer the same question rather than racing the open web. Only fixtures whose prior steps are actually populated can be used: a fixture carrying nothing but a goal makes the agent ask a clarifying question instead of drafting, which is correct behaviour and useless as a comparison. That leaves three, below the six-case power floor — see the note in AGENTS.md.
